facts.title: Experience League: Adobe Marketo Qualifier overview
facts.quote: Adobe Marketo Qualifier is an AI-powered app that automates prospect qualification, outreach, and cross-channel buyer engagement for business development representatives (BDRs). The Account Qualification Agent analyzes your accounts and prospects, prioritizes those that are ready for the next step, and drafts personalized outreach based on your CRM data.
facts.supports: Adobe's description of Marketo Qualifier.

facts.title: Experience League: Adobe Marketo Qualifier overview
facts.quote: The app is part of the Marketo product family, alongside Marketo Engage, Marketo Optimizer, and Marketo Measure.
facts.supports: Marketo Qualifier belongs to the Marketo product family.

facts.title: Experience League: Get started with Adobe Marketo Qualifier
facts.quote: After Adobe provisions Marketo Qualifier for your organization, a Marketo system administrator must create the required user groups and connect Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365.
facts.supports: The one-time setup: user groups and a CRM connection, after Adobe provisions the app.

facts.title: Experience League: Manage integrations
facts.quote: Your CRM administrator prepares API access in Salesforce or Dynamics. A Marketo Qualifier administrator then connects the CRM, maps inbound fields, and chooses whether to synchronize activities. The initial connection requires read-only access. Activity synchronization and opt-out write-back require the corresponding write access.
facts.supports: Who does what in the CRM connection, and the access each part needs.

facts.title: Experience League: Admin settings
facts.quote: Marketo Qualifier reads users, contacts, owner mappings, leads, accounts, opportunities, and activities from the CRM. It writes only logged outreach activities and opt-out status to the CRM, and it synchronizes outreach activities to Marketo.
facts.supports: What Marketo Qualifier reads from and writes to the CRM.

facts.title: Experience League: Manage integrations
facts.quote: Inbound mapping controls which CRM fields Marketo Qualifier imports and where they appear.
facts.supports: Inbound field mapping.

facts.title: Experience League: Manage integrations
facts.quote: Representatives can see the activities in the CRM, while marketing teams can use the Marketo activities in lead scoring and engagement timelines.
facts.supports: Synced outreach activities are visible in the CRM and usable in Marketo.

facts.title: Experience League: Create and manage Outbound Workflows
facts.quote: An Outbound Workflow is a goal-driven outreach cadence. You define the goal and targeting criteria. AI then proposes a multitouch cadence and writes personalized email content for each prospect. Before you activate the cadence, review and approve each email.
facts.supports: How an Outbound Workflow drafts outreach and that each email is reviewed and approved.

facts.title: Experience League: Create and manage Outbound Workflows
facts.quote: The cadence can include email, phone call, and LinkedIn InMail steps.
facts.supports: The steps a cadence can hold.

facts.title: Experience League: Create and manage Outbound Workflows
facts.quote: Marketo Qualifier does not send email until you approve it.
facts.supports: No email is sent without approval.

facts.title: Experience League: Create and manage Outbound Workflows
facts.quote: Only the prospect’s owner can approve or reject a draft.
facts.supports: Who can approve a draft.

facts.title: Experience League: Admin settings
facts.quote: The Knowledge Center gives the Account Qualification Agent (AQA) access to your sales materials. Marketo Qualifier uses these materials to generate research, qualification insights, and outreach that reflect how your organization sells.
facts.supports: The Knowledge Center grounds the outreach in the organization's own sales materials.

facts.title: Experience League: Live Chat and Meeting Booking Overview
facts.quote: Live chat and meeting booking are the two ways Brand Concierge hands that conversation to a human without losing the context the visitor already provided.
facts.supports: The two ways Brand Concierge hands a conversation to a person.

facts.title: Experience League: Set Up Representatives in Adobe Marketo Qualifier

facts.supports: Representatives are set up in Marketo Qualifier first.

facts.title: Experience League: Route Conversations to Representatives
facts.quote: Every eligible representative is notified of the incoming chat at the same time, and the first one to accept takes the conversation.

facts.title: Experience League: Adobe Marketo Qualifier overview

facts.supports: The Organization Performance view.

facts.title: Experience League: Outbound performance in Adobe Marketo Qualifier
facts.quote: Active prospects, open rate, click rate, reply rate, and meetings booked.
facts.supports: The measures shown for each Outbound Workflow campaign.

facts.title: Experience League: Outbound performance in Adobe Marketo Qualifier
facts.quote: Campaign Performance reports on outbound results by Outbound Workflow campaign:

facts.title: Experience League: Route Conversations to Representatives
facts.quote: Custom routing is the one part of live chat and meeting booking that requires Adobe Marketo Engage, because the rules are built on Marketo lead and company attributes.
facts.supports: Custom routing needs Marketo Engage.

facts.title: Experience League: Manage integrations
facts.quote: Activity sync requires write access in your CRM.
facts.supports: Activity sync needs CRM write access.

facts.supports: AI person summaries depend on a Marketo Optimizer edition.

facts.title: Experience League: Adobe Marketo Optimizer Documentation
facts.quote: Adobe Marketo Optimizer is an AI-first marketing automation solution that empowers marketers and business development representatives (BDRs) to bring their lead, account, and buying group journeys together with powerful AI reasoning that enriches customer context with continuously updated semantic stories and scales engagement with next-best actions across marketing, paid media, and BDR channels.
facts.supports: Adobe's description of Marketo Optimizer.

facts.title: Experience League: Person Journeys
facts.quote: In Adobe Marketo Optimizer, person journeys are automated, multistep lead-based marketing plans that orchestrate personalized experiences across channels. These journeys use Marketo Engage data to execute these marketing plans in response to engagement, business events, or scheduled campaigns.
facts.supports: What a person journey is, and that it runs on Marketo Engage data.

facts.title: Experience League: Event-based Audiences
facts.quote: When a qualifying activity is logged in Marketo Engage for a lead and replicated into Adobe Marketo Optimizer, the system evaluates the corresponding person record against your configured filters and constraints. If the conditions are met, the person enters the journey immediately through the Audience node.
facts.supports: Marketo Engage activities bring people into a journey.

facts.title: Experience League: Take an Action Node
facts.quote: Use this action to add people to a request campaign in a connected Marketo Engage instance.
facts.supports: A journey action can request a Marketo Engage campaign.

facts.title: Experience League: Take an Action Node
facts.quote: Use this action to change the status of a person in a Marketo Engage program.
facts.supports: A journey action can change a person's status in a Marketo Engage program.

facts.title: Experience League: User Access and Permissions
facts.quote: For each user type, you create a user group in the Admin Console and a role in Experience Platform, and then add the group to the role.
facts.supports: How access is set up.

facts.title: Experience League: Email Deliverability Configuration
facts.quote: Create one or more email channel configurations that bind a subdomain, IP pool, and sender identity.
facts.supports: Email channel configurations.

facts.title: Experience League: Email Deliverability Configuration
facts.quote: Subdomains isolate your B2B marketing reputation from corporate or transactional mail.
facts.supports: Why a sending subdomain is delegated.

facts.title: Experience League: Email Deliverability Configuration
facts.quote: Treat deliverability and channel setup as a one-time administrator activity. When configured, marketers and email authors do not need to revisit it.
facts.supports: Email sending setup is a one-time administrator task.

facts.title: Experience League: Email Deliverability Configuration
facts.quote: Delegate full DNS authority for the subdomain to Adobe. Adobe creates and maintains MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, A, and CNAME records.
facts.supports: The Fully Delegated method.

facts.title: Experience League: Email Deliverability Configuration
facts.quote: Keep DNS authority on your side and create CNAME records pointing to Adobe-managed records.
facts.supports: The CNAME method.

facts.title: Experience League: Next Best Path Node
facts.quote: brings AI-driven split path decisioning directly into the journey canvas. Instead of configuring filter conditions on a split paths node, you describe your intent in natural language and let the system determine the most relevant path for each person.
facts.supports: The Next best path node.

facts.title: Experience League: Next Best Path Node
facts.quote: The next best path node evaluates that context to make an intelligent routing decision, while letting you review, modify, or override any AI recommendation before activating the journey.
facts.supports: AI recommendations can be reviewed, changed or overridden before the journey is activated.

facts.title: Experience League: Next Best Path Node
facts.quote: Each decision is logged with a confidence score and natural-language reasoning for transparency and observability.
facts.supports: Each AI decision is logged with its reasoning.

facts.title: Experience League: Journey Traffic Control
facts.quote: Journey traffic control (JTC) prioritizes the best journey for a person when audiences overlap. When a person qualifies for multiple JTC-enabled journeys, an AI model evaluates them against each candidate and adds them to the best-fit journey, holding them out of the others.
facts.supports: Journey traffic control.

facts.title: Experience League: Chat interface
facts.quote: The chat panel is embedded throughout Adobe Marketo Optimizer. It is where you interact with the AI agents using plain language to build programs and journeys, create and compare people lists, investigate leads, configure scoring, and more.
facts.supports: The Coworker chat panel.

facts.title: Experience League: Chat interface
facts.quote: The system checks every skill or action in chat against the same permissions that the feature needs outside chat
facts.supports: Chat follows the user's product permissions.

facts.title: Experience League: Chat interface
facts.quote: If you lack the feature permission, Coworker cannot perform that action for you.
facts.supports: Coworker cannot do what the user has no permission to do.

facts.title: Experience League: Generate Analytics Reports
facts.quote: Use it in the Coworker chat interface to explore activity trends, email performance, lead and account data, segment and list membership, and journey metrics. Results return as charts and tables, so you don’t need to build a query or dashboard manually.
facts.supports: Reporting through Coworker chat.

facts.title: Experience League: Destinations
facts.quote: Destinations are pre-built integrations that let you send static people lists from Marketo Optimizer to external advertising or social platforms, such as a LinkedIn campaign audience, a Google Customer Match audience, or a Facebook Custom Audience. Activating a static list to a destination keeps membership in sync: as people are added to or removed from the list, they are correspondingly added to or removed from the destination audience
facts.supports: Destinations send static people lists to ad platforms and keep them in sync.

facts.title: Experience League: Take an Action Node
facts.quote: Use this action to add people to a static list and activate that list to a destination directly from your journey.
facts.supports: A journey can activate a list to a destination.

cautions.text: Marketo Qualifier setup: Adobe provisions the app before your work starts, and the Salesforce or Dynamics administrator on your client's side has to prepare API access. Do not promise a start date that depends on either.
cautions.quote: After Adobe provisions Marketo Qualifier for your organization, a Marketo system administrator must create the required user groups and connect Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365.

cautions.text: Marketo Qualifier activity sync: writing outreach activities and opt-outs back needs write access in the CRM, beyond the read-only access of the first connection. Confirm your client's CRM administrator will grant it before you promise activities in the CRM or in Marketo.
cautions.quote: Activity sync requires write access in your CRM.

cautions.text: Brand Concierge hand-off: custom routing rules need Marketo Engage, because they are built on Marketo lead and company attributes. Without it, promise round robin or a named representative only.
cautions.quote: Custom routing is the one part of live chat and meeting booking that requires Adobe Marketo Engage, because the rules are built on Marketo lead and company attributes.

cautions.text: Marketo Qualifier AI person summaries: Adobe ties them to instances running Marketo Optimizer Prime or Ultimate. Check what your client has licensed before you mention them.
cautions.quote: AI person summaries are available on instances running Marketo Optimizer Prime or Ultimate.

cautions.text: Marketo Qualifier AI Chat: Adobe says availability depends on the organization's configuration and the user's permissions, so do not promise it to every representative.
cautions.quote: AI Chat availability depends on your organization's configuration and your permissions.

cautions.text: Marketo Qualifier LinkedIn steps: a cadence can include LinkedIn InMail steps, but they are tasks a representative completes; Adobe documents no LinkedIn integration that sends them. Do not promise automated LinkedIn messages.
cautions.quote: The cadence can include email, phone call, and LinkedIn InMail steps.

cautions.text: Marketo Qualifier Smart audience carries a release label on Adobe's pages. It is left out of every sentence; do not offer it in a response.
cautions.quote: Build target lists with Smart audience (Beta) by describing accounts in plain language, adding CRM data and growth signals, and reviewing scored leads for an Outbound Workflow.

cautions.text: Marketo Optimizer release: Adobe's guide describes the current release with a release label and lists capabilities that are not in it. Confirm with Adobe what your client can use before you propose Marketo Optimizer, and keep to what the sentences say.
cautions.quote: For the Beta release of Marketo Optimizer, the following default personas are defined according to the job title attribute:

cautions.text: Marketo Optimizer email sending: the shared IP pool managed by Adobe is the only option, and the sending subdomain is set up with the Fully Delegated or CNAME method. Do not promise dedicated IPs, an IP warmup plan or your client keeping its own certificates.
cautions.quote: The shared IP pool is the only option.

cautions.text: Marketo Optimizer destinations: only LinkedIn Matched Audience, Google Customer Match and Facebook Custom Audience are available, for static lists. Do not promise another ad platform or the wider Experience Platform destinations catalog.
cautions.quote: only these destinations are currently available for activation in Marketo Optimizer

cautions.text: Marketo Optimizer journey traffic control: a person is placed in only one traffic-controlled journey at a time. Do not promise the same person in several of those journeys at once.
cautions.quote: Currently, a person can be placed in only one JTC-selected journey at a time.

cautions.text: Marketo Optimizer Coworker: the commands a user sees depend on which features Adobe has enabled for the account, and some are shown but inactive. Scoring Studio sits under a Labs label. Promise only the chat uses named in the sentences.
cautions.quote: The available set depends on which features are enabled for you.

cautions.text: Marketo Optimizer reporting through Coworker: report data refreshes every two hours, so do not promise live figures.
cautions.quote: Report data refreshes every two hours.

cautions.text: Marketo Optimizer setup: Adobe provisions the product and binds its sandboxes before access can be set up. Do not promise a start date that depends on it.
cautions.quote: After provisioning is complete and sandboxes are bound, complete the following steps to provide Marketo Optimizer access for your team and users.
